parameter.name: CH_HP_Q_X10
parameter.what: issue #559: the CH high-pass's Q x10 (M_CHHP, f0 held at 11.7 kHz, which R153/R155/C72/C73 fix under any equal-C Sallen-Key reading). The shipped Q 2.5 is reference 11's [inferred] topology reading. M_CHHP is shared with the cymbal's short high band (E_CYS).

objective.name: CH flatness ratio to the #379 WEAK bar
objective.why: #559's named CH failure: worst feature 9.3x (gate-379 section 4) is flatness. The ratio is to the take played x1.0628 (WEAK), a ranking bar, not a calibrated between-recording one.

range_basis: 25 ships. 5 (Q 0.5) bounds the low side: below it a 2-pole high-pass is overdamped and its corner response no longer changes shape. The skirt diagnosis (1/3-octave, 0-60 ms: ours 5-10 dB short below 6 kHz, 2-6 dB hot above 12 kHz) said the resonant bump is the excess, so the grid spans 0.5 to the shipped 2.5.
Committed in tools/probes/chcp_559_select.py (module docstring and grid constants, committed in b10a6e8f before any DEV point was rendered)

decision_rule.why: the gate's own resolution, not the spread of these data: a candidate is only told apart from another if the gap is a meaningful fraction of the 808's own one-step distance (the WEAK bar). At the ratios swept here (2 to 27) one bar is 4 to 50 % of the value; 10 % is the low end of that, so two points closer than 10 % are within the gate's own step and cannot justify a choice. Stated in this record before it was checked, from the decision's granularity.

evidence.regenerate: python3 tools/probes/chcp_559.py ch-sweep|cp-sweep, then python3 tools/probes/chcp_559.py tables
evidence.instrument: tools/probes/chcp_559.py through tools/perceptual_gate.py UNCHANGED (#379 gate, WEAK bar, single Fischer take); objective = median over the 5 frozen DEV strikes (480, 23110, 25283, 25409, 28527 frames) of the ratio to the bar. CH renders: the real DrumsFx block. CP renders: the exact fast path, asserted bit-identical to the real block (check-fast).

prediction.basis: The committed sentence (CH-1, PREDICTIONS, b10a6e8f): 'flatness falls monotonically from Q 2.5 to about Q 0.7 and flattens below (the ~12 dB/oct skirt below f0 does not depend on Q; only the resonant bump does)'. Translated to runs under the 10 % rule mechanically: Q 0.5 and 0.7 one run, each step above it separate. The translation was written down after the measurement; the sentence it translates was not.

verdict.summary: As predicted: 8.87 (shipped, Q 2.5), 7.32, 6.32, 5.62, 5.21 (Q 0.5); Q 0.5 and 0.7 are within 10 %. Every other CH feature also improves or holds at Q 0.5 (centroid 3.18 -> 1.17, spec_peak 3.33 -> 2.58, attack 1.31 -> 1.03; ch-sweep-dev.json). The shipped value sits at the worst end. The disabled candidate kit_808_candidate_559() carries Q 0.5; kit_808() still ships 2.5.

limits: DEV only; the selected point's CONFIRM result is docs/scorecard/chcp-559/ch-confirm-hpq05.json.
The ratio is to the #379 WEAK bar, which ranks; no calibrated between-recording bar exists (gate-379 section 8), so fidelity qualification is REFUSED whatever this record says.
f0 was held at 11.7 kHz by design; a 10 kHz / Q 0.5 exploration at the default strike read 5.62 against 6.08 at 11.7 kHz (not on this grid, not used to select).
